metadata.title: Clicked like I was swatting a fly and somehow snagged that 1 clueless soul?! Valorant logic again
metadata.description:
Me: spazzing like I forgot the shoot button exists
Enemy: probably questioning their life choices
How did that even connect? No clue but I’m cashing in
If your aim’s a beautiful disaster, welcome to the madness
